All spec requirements pass, and so does the full tailwindcss vitest run (5017 passed, 1 skipped). Prettier is clean. Probes show that variants, important, the prefix option, (--x) shorthand values, names with digits or uppercase, and IntelliSense listing all work. Escaped names and non-ASCII names produce no CSS. The defects are all minor: underscores in arbitrary values become spaces (inherited Tailwind behavior), anchor--x gives ---x, the bare-value handler is duplicated, the changelog entry has no PR link, and the tests cover a little less than they could. A maintainer would likely merge it with small edits.

defects.what: Arbitrary and var-shorthand values are not type-checked, so values that are clearly not anchor names produce invalid declarations. This is allowed by the spec's 'pass through' wording, but some other name-style utilities restrict them.
defects.evidence: Probe run(['anchor-[12px]','anchored-[#fff]','anchor-(color:--x)']) printed `anchor-name: 12px;`, `position-anchor: #fff;`, `anchor-name: var(--x);`

defects.what: The keywords swap between the two utilities without any guard: `anchored-none` gives `position-anchor: --none` and `anchor-auto` gives `anchor-name: --auto`. The spec allows this, but users could find it surprising.
defects.evidence: Probe output: `.anchored-none { position-anchor: --none; }`, `.anchor-auto { anchor-name: --auto; }`

defects.what: The CHANGELOG entry has no PR link, while the neighbouring entries carry `([#NNNN](...))`.
defects.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:13 `- Add `anchor-*` and `anchored-*` utilities for CSS anchor positioning`

defects.what: The bare-name regex and handler are copy-pasted between the two utilities instead of shared through a small helper.
defects.evidence: packages/tailwindcss/src/utilities.ts:667-693 (diff hunk): the same `/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/` handleBareValue appears twice

strengths: Uses the existing functionalUtility + staticValues mechanism, so `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto` show up in getClassList automatically, and the intellisense snapshot was updated to match
Gets precedence right: handleBareValue runs before staticValues, so it explicitly returns null for 'none'/'auto' to let the static keyword win
Adds anchor-name and position-anchor to property-order.ts right after position, so the utilities sort in a sensible place (probe: relative=0, anchor-x=1, anchored-x=2, z-10=3)
Tests use the repo's inline-snapshot style and cover arbitrary values, the `(--x)` shorthand, bare utility names, negative forms, modifiers, fractions and dotted values, all producing ''

Handles edge cases correctly: digits and uppercase pass through (anchor-2 -> --2, anchor-Tooltip -> --Tooltip), underscores in arbitrary values become spaces, and variants and important (both `!` positions) work
Full suite passes (5017 passed, 1 skipped) and Prettier is clean on all changed files
